en: This is a vintage illustrated postcard showing a scenic view of a European city with a river running through it, several bridges spanning the river, and a prominent hill with a fortress-like complex and a clock tower on top. The foreground includes classic European buildings with red roofs. The lower part of the postcard features printed text, and there is handwritten text along the right margin.
